title: 16 Event Marketing Strategies & Ideas for 2026 (+ Examples)

facts.fact: Verified Market Research's 2022 forecast expects the events industry to reach USD 2,194.40 billion by 2028 (third-party forecast).
facts.quote: According to a 2022 forecast by Verified Market Research, the events industry is expected to reach USD 2,194.40 billion by 2028.

facts.fact: Markletic reports that 45% of B2B event organizers expect at least a 3x ROI one year after the event (third-party claim).
facts.quote: Markletic reports that 45% of B2B event organizers expect at least a 3x ROI one year after the event.

facts.fact: Livestorm's 2026 Webinar Benchmark Report, based on 33,786 sessions, found that 86.3% of teams rely on email to drive registrations.
facts.quote: Livestorm's [2026 Webinar Benchmark Report](https://livestorm.co/webinar-benchmark-report-2026), based on 33,786 sessions, shows that 86.3% of teams rely on email to drive registrations

facts.fact: Livestorm's 2026 Webinar Benchmark Report found that 49.6% of registrations happen in the final seven days before an online event.
facts.quote: nearly half of registrations (49.6%) happen in the final seven days

facts.fact: Livestorm's 2026 Webinar Benchmark Report, based on 33,786 sessions, reports an average show-up rate of 47.7%.
facts.quote: the average show-up rate is 47.7%

facts.fact: Livestorm's 2025 data shows webinar participants convert at 4x the rate of non-participants (vendor's own data).
facts.quote: Livestorm's 2025 data shows webinar participants convert at 4x the rate of non-participants.

facts.fact: The page gives an example B2B event goal of getting more than 50% attendance rate out of signups.
facts.quote: Get more than 50% of attendance rate out of signups

facts.fact: The page gives an example B2B event goal of increasing the prospects list by 50 names and contact information.
facts.quote: Increase the prospects list by 50 names and contact information

facts.fact: The page gives an example goal of scoring at least 4.5/5 in the post-attendance feedback survey.
facts.quote: Get a score of at least 4.5/5 in the post-attendance feedback survey

facts.fact: Livestorm's page states that nearly half of webinar registrations (49.6%) come in the final 7 days before the event.
facts.quote: Nearly half of webinar registrations (49.6%) come in this window.

facts.fact: Livestorm recommends splitting online event promotion as 20% early, 50% in the middle, and 30% in the final week rather than front-loading it.
facts.quote: a 20/50/30 split (20% of your promotion early, 50% in the middle, 30% in the final week) usually works better than front-loading it

facts.fact: In Livestorm's sample timeline, the registration page should be published 4 to 6 weeks before the event.
facts.quote: 4 to 6 weeks before | Publish the registration page, confirm speakers and partners, and prepare promo assets

facts.fact: In Livestorm's sample timeline, the first invitation to segmented email lists is sent 3 to 4 weeks before the event.
facts.quote: 3 to 4 weeks before | Send the first invitation to segmented email lists, announce on social media, and launch paid campaigns if you use them.

facts.fact: In Livestorm's sample timeline, a second invitation is sent 1 to 2 weeks before the event.
facts.quote: 1 to 2 weeks before | Send a second invitation, ask speakers and partners to share, and publish teaser content.

facts.fact: Livestorm advises that in-person events need longer lead times and should start the promotion sequence two to three months out.
facts.quote: In-person events need longer lead times for travel and tickets, so start the same sequence two to three months out

facts.fact: Livestorm recommends sending the replay and a recap within 24 hours after an online event.
facts.quote: After the event | Send the replay and a recap within 24 hours, share clips, and hand engaged attendees to sales.

facts.fact: The article recommends sending a final reminder email to registrants 24-48 hours before the event to boost attendance rates.
facts.quote: Send registrants an email reminder 24-48 hours before the event to boost attendance rates.

facts.fact: Livestorm, the vendor, describes its platform as suitable for hosting large events of up to 3,000 attendees.
facts.quote: Livestorm is one of the most complete options for hosting large (3,000 attendees), interactive, and analytical platforms you’ll find.

facts.fact: Livestorm states that it is a browser-based platform, so participants can access events easily.
facts.quote: Giving easy access to participants as it’s a browser-based platform

facts.fact: Livestorm states its event analytics include number of attendees, replay views, number of sessions, average duration, and traffic data.
facts.quote: Livestorm gives you useful insights like the number of attendees, replay views, number of sessions, average duration, and traffic data.

facts.fact: Livestorm's engagement features include live polls, Q&A, live chat, emoji reactions, and CTA buttons during online or hybrid events.
facts.quote: you can make use of these interactive elements to enhance the user experience: Live polls Q&A Live chat Emoji reactions CTAs
